title.en: Try Again: the poem in brief

text.en:
Meena fell off her bicycle but climbed back on.
"I will try again," she said.

This poem urges us not to give up. If we fail at first, we should try again and again, because the more we practise, the better we do.
It reminds us that nobody becomes good at something at once, and that effort and patience bring success.
The theme is perseverance, which means to keep trying. This summary is based on the well-known story or poem and on public chapter notes. Please read the exact text in the textbook, because the textbook version may differ in details.

text.en: The poem says failing is not the end.
